title: Phase 4: US2 – Prevent invalid profile updates (T052–T062)

description: T052 – domain validation tests (aggregate + value objects)
notes: Created CustomerAggregate_ProfileValidation_Tests.cs covering required names, supported gender enum, past DOB via CustomerDateOfBirth value object, and no-events-on-failure invariant.

Created UpdateCustomerProfileValidationTests.cs covering CustomerProfileValidator (names, email format, gender, DOB) and CustomerEmailUniquenessService field-specific error messages for verified/pending conflicts.

description: T054 – API contract tests for validation problem responses
notes: Created CustomerProfileValidationApiTests.cs: empty first/last name → 422 with field error, invalid email → 422, future DOB → 422, valid update → 200 regression, profile unchanged after validation failure.

description: T055 – Web service validation mapping tests
notes: Created CustomerProfileValidationTests.cs: 422→field errors in ResultDto, 409→email field error, unchanged profile on failure, 200 regression test.

Created CustomerProfileValidator with CustomerProfileValidationResult. Validates: firstName/lastName (required, ≤100 chars), email format (required, regex), gender (Enum.IsDefined), dateOfBirth (must be past). All field keys camelCase to match JSON.

Enriched CustomerProfileValidationException with FieldErrors dict + new constructor. Updated CustomerEmailUniquenessService to throw with email field error (distinct messages for VerifiedEmail vs PendingEmail conflict). Wired CustomerProfileValidator into UpdateCustomerProfileCommandHandler – validates before any aggregate/persistence work.
Handler already updated in T057 step – CustomerProfileValidator injected as constructor parameter and called at start of Handle before any persistence work.

description: T059 – Field-level error responses in middleware & mappings
notes: Updated DomainExceptionMiddleware: CustomerProfileValidationException with FieldErrors → 422 ValidationProblemDetails with errors dict (handled before generic switch). Registered CustomerProfileValidator in DI via DependencyInjection.cs.
EditProfileModal.razor already renders fieldErrors[field] per field for firstName, lastName, email, dateOfBirth from US1. No changes needed.

description: T061 – CustomerProfileService email field error on 409
notes: Updated CustomerProfileService: 409 Conflict now returns ResultDto with FieldErrors["email"] so the UI renders the email field error inline rather than a generic top-level message.

All tests pass: CustomerDomain 124/124, Web.Tests 24/24. Fixed regression in MartenCustomerEmailUniquenessCheckerTests (now expects CustomerProfileValidationException instead of DuplicateCustomerEmailException). Updated CustomerProfileHandlerTests BuildUpdateHandler to pass new CustomerProfileValidator arg. Updated existing 409 assertion in CustomerProfileServiceTests to check FieldErrors["email"] instead of Message.
